title: WHAT GOD CANNOT DO DOES NOT EXIST

Somebody you know is about to lay down their faith and say it is over. But this message is their [music] lifeline. Share it quickly. Neither the son of man that he should repent. Had he said, and shall he not [music] do it? Or had he spoken and shall he not make it good?" God is about to make his word good in your life.
